ground_truth: methylation-derived leukocyte fraction, Thorsson et al. 2018 Immunity 48(4); 2,000 differentially methylated loci, mixture model
denominator_caveat: an mRNA proportion of an eight-type roster against a DNA-derived cell fraction of the whole sample. The roster drops 7.0% of the atlas including some leukocytes, and immune cells carry ~2.245x less mRNA than tumour cells; both bias the estimate DOWNWARD, so an over-call finding is conservative.

excluded_from_comparison.bisque: requires subjects assayed as BOTH bulk and single cells; Bisque's method IS the assay transform learned from paired subjects. Without overlap it estimates that transform from marginal distributions, which is its documented degraded mode. TCGA has no single-cell data, so this is not fixable from any file on disk -- it needs a genuinely paired cohort.
excluded_from_comparison.quantiseq: requires its own TIL10 signature and a matching gene space; quanTIseq ignores the supplied reference. It is reported separately wherever it runs, and it returned no finite estimates on either TCGA cohort.
excluded_from_comparison.music: requires cross-donor variance (sigma) in the reference; MuSiC's entire contribution is weighting genes by cross-donor consistency. With a zero sigma it is residual-weighted NNLS, and returns numbers identical to NNLS.
excluded_from_comparison.epic: requires refProfiles.var (per-gene variance) in the reference; EPIC's published contribution is variance weighting. Without it the package warns and runs constrained least squares with uniform weights.
excluded_from_comparison.scdc_ensemble: requires two or more references to weight across; With one reference there is nothing to ensemble; it reduces exactly to SCDC.
excluded_from_comparison.cibersortx_smode: requires the single cells the signature was built from; S-mode's batch correction is defined against the source cells; without them the method cannot run at all.

why_exclusion_matters: a method whose intended input was unavailable was not evaluated; ranking it would report this experiment's limitation as a property of the method. Excluded from every statistic, reported with its numbers under availability.
